summary: Frontend-only testing of static site served at /site/*.html. Ran 73 assertions across HOME, ADMIN, BLOG, CONTACT, TOOLS, SECURITY, RESPONSIVE, and PERFORMANCE areas via Playwright. 70/73 passed. All functional requirements pass (nav, theme toggle+persistence, cookie banner, skip link, alt text, revenue counter $4,820,000, admin stats $996,760/2000/$498.38/9925, 25 rows/page, sort, search, pagination, delete-by-id, Chart.js render, Export CSV, logout, blog featured+9 per page, likes toggle, reading progress, contact modal closed-on-load, escape closes, forum XSS-safe with nx-threads key, all 7 tools return correct values incl. ui_bugs.issue: Horizontal scroll at 320px (scrollWidth=520) and 375px (scrollWidth=548). Root cause: `.hero-orbit` SPAN has intrinsic width ~720px overflowing viewport. Also `.marquee-track` is 2188px wide — its parent needs `overflow:hidden` (and likely already has it, but hero-orbit does not clip). The hero-orbit likely needs `max-width:100%` or the parent container needs `overflow-x:hidden`.
Two `.card.stat` elements have right=327 at 320px viewport — ~7px overflow. Add responsive grid/flex-wrap or reduce padding at <=360px.
`#blog-pager` overflows by 7px at 320px (right=327). Number buttons don't wrap. Add flex-wrap or reduce button gaps/padding at <=360px.

action_items: Fix horizontal overflow on index.html at 320px/375px: constrain `.hero-orbit` width (add max-width:100% or clip within a container with overflow:hidden) and ensure `.marquee-track` parent has overflow-x:hidden.
Fix minor 7px overflow on blog.html `#blog-pager` at 320px — allow buttons to wrap with `flex-wrap:wrap` and/or reduce gap on ultra-narrow screens.
Same 7px overflow on index.html `.card.stat` at 320px — likely same cause (grid item min-width). Add `min-width:0` on grid children or a mobile-only single-column layout.
